q: My opponent has 8 cards in their trash.
Can I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to trash the top 2 cards of their deck, then process the part of the effect after "then"?
My opponent has 11 cards in their trash.
This card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect doesn't trash the top 2 cards of their deck, but can I process the part of the effect after "then"?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has 10 or fewer cards in their trash, trash the top 2 cards of both players' decks. Then, if they have 10 or more cards in their trash, gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Trash the top card of both players' decks.
